output.summary: A fig tree native to Africa south of the Sahel and north of the Tropic of Capricorn, excluding central-west rainforest areas, the sycamore fig has a dense, spreading crown and green-yellow to orange bark that peels away in papery strips. Depending on the variety, it fruits year-round from April or later, producing thick clusters of edible figs that ripen yellow or red.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit is edible; fruiting begins in April or later depending on variety and may continue year-round.
